name: Diageo Plainfield Distribution Warehouse - Plainfield IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Large cross-dock distribution warehouse. The truck path runs from an open access road along the south side, through a gap in the employee parking, into the east dock yard. No barrier arm or sliding gate at the public road; Street View (2024-07) at the SE/SW corners shows open driveways. A small orange structure sits at the east dock-yard pinch point (41.6243,-88.2468) but reads as a yard office among trailers, not a multi-window guard booth at a gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly identifiable staffed guard booth at a controlled gate. Two small structures near the east dock-yard entrance are ambiguous from overhead; flagged uncertain. No barrier arm to guard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: True (moderate confidence) - the building is a true cross-dock with continuous dock doors on BOTH the east and west long faces, each face fronted by its own drop yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Continuous dock doors run nearly the full length of both the ~700m east and west building faces. Estimate ~130 total doors (band 50+). Moderate confidence - count is from overhead rhythm of bays and backed-in trailers.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large drop yards on both faces full of parked trailers (many without tractors); ~160 trailers visible, capacity ~220.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved access road and dock-yard aprons with ample unused width for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single very large building (one mass). The separate gravel trucking lots to the SE are unrelated third-party operations, not part of this property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge of Plainfield IL surrounded by active farmland; Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
